video_title: Jaylen Brown Says He Was SNUBBED From First Team All-NBA… Was He?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: debating if Jaylen Brown deserved a first-team All-NBA selection
quotes.excerpt: we're not talking about five best players we're talking about five best seasons

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Jaylen Brown is not one of the five best players.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: We're not talking about five best players, we're talking about five best seasons. Look at those guys and we can look at MVP voting. Those guys all probably have more MVP votes than he did. Jaylen Brown was upset, but be upset. It's like, dog, you're sixth, sort of? That's not even a real thing. It's, I mean, yes, be mad because you're competitive, but understand that you can't have four guards up there. You can't have Cade Cunningham, SGA, Luka Doncic, you, and Jokic. You can't have that happen.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: addressing the narrative that players are snubbed due to lack of popularity
quotes.excerpt: I just don't want that narrative be pushed that people don't like you
quotes.quote: When they say you got snubbed, okay, well then tell me who you should take off. And he can say, I feel like I was the best player in the league this year and I had my best season. And that's okay. But I just don't want that narrative be pushed that people don't like you. Bro, you were voted for Finals MVP. Jaylen Brown, we'd love to have you on Road Trippin'.
